units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 109:3">Yalk. Gen. 109</cite> <he>הכיר בו שמְרוּצָתוֹ לרעה</he> (some ed. <he>שמְרִיצָ׳</he>) he (Eliezer) recognized that his (Laban’s) running was for evil.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 63">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXIII</cite> ed. Bub. <he>היה רץ … במ׳</he> would run after the horse in speed.
